newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar pares gains but trade supports.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar pares gains but trade supports.

text.p: Nearby white sugar futures turned a touch lower on Wednesday afternoon with the modest turnover boosted by crossed against actuals trades, market sources said. Steady trade crossing and scale-down buying throughout the session kept the March and May values supported and countered the light selling from commission houses, they said.
"It's a real mixed bag, there are no great trades," said one trader, noting some white/raw premium business above the market.
More attention would be given to the March/March differential as the spot whites contract neared its expiry on February 13, he said.
By 1650 GMT March had clawed back some lost ground to hover just above $308.00 support, unchanged at $308.20. May was down 80 cents at $306.30 and overall volume stood at 1,017 lots.
Technical analysts said there was still hope for market bulls while the spot value remained above its 40-day moving average at $303.90, which is acting as critical chart support.
But March's five-day momentum indicator has slipped down into negative territory while the 10-day line is falling steadily towards zero.
The position is also trading under its 10-day average at $308.70 and below a trendline created as the result of a month-long rally up from December's nadir of $295.10.
The Matif exchange was relatively quiet with just 232 lots traded. March was down 90 cents at $307.80 and May down $1.20 at $307.00.
